editorial:
Ever wonder if your old high school bullies actually changed? You will feel that tension right away as you watch a group of former classmates meet up for their 20 year reunion. The vibe starts off like a normal get-together, but it quickly turns into something much heavier. One woman decides to speak her truth about how she was treated and outcast back in the day. It is wild to see how fast these adults forget their maturity and slide right back into the mean roles they played as teenagers. You will find yourself leaning in as the group dynamic shifts from polite small talk to a heated social battle.

The acting feels so real that you might forget you are watching a movie. The biggest draw here is the massive twist that changes everything you thought you knew about the plot. While the slow buildup might feel a bit long for some, the payoff is totally worth it. If you like stories that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: You find out that the entire reunion was actually a social experiment. The woman who was bullied is the director of the film, and she hired actors to play her former classmates. She wanted to see if people would actually apologize or just go back to being mean. The movie ends with the actors breaking character and the director reflecting on the results, showing that people rarely change their deep-seated habits.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves social experiments and unexpected plot twists.
